title: Auxiliary-variable budget bound
statement: Let $V$ be a Boolean PCPP system with $r$ verifier queries, and let $s$ be any seed of its verifier. If $3\le r$, then $(r-3)$ times the size of the seed's acceptance CNF formula, plus $3$, is at most $r2^r$.
